subject: music

moments.title: DJ Kool Herc's party
moments.who: Cindy Campbell and Clive Campbell, Bronx
moments.body: An 11 August birthday party at 1520 Sedgwick Avenue is later identified as hip-hop's founding event.
moments.takeaway: Cultural histories can be dated to a single block party.

moments.title: Rapper's Delight
moments.body: The 14-minute single becomes the first commercially successful hip-hop record.
moments.takeaway: Underground innovations reach mass audiences through small labels.

moments.title: Public Enemy and N.W.A albums
moments.body: It Takes a Nation of Millions to Hold Us Back and Straight Outta Compton politicise hip-hop nationally.
moments.takeaway: Hip-hop developed multiple regional voices in parallel.

now.title: Hip-hop today
now.body: Hip-hop is the most-streamed genre in the US (RIAA 2017 onwards). It has globalised through K-pop, Afrobeats and UK drill.
now.open_questions: How do regional hip-hops change the global sound?

reflection: What started in the Bronx is now the lingua franca of pop.
